headline: Long-read methods are validated against orthogonal reference or truth data
label: Long Read Benchmarking And Calibration
summary: Fresh preprints and an eLife benchmark test long-read methylation and RNA modification calling against reference data.
synthesis: The common thread is validation of long-read and nanopore analyses against controls or reference data, with conclusions tied to data type. An eLife study benchmarks Dorado versions for direct-RNA m6A calling against GLORI and proposes stringent filtering. A preprint finds that ADAR-deficient controls and sufficient depth are essential for evaluating Dorado's inosine model for A-to-I editing. Siphon-seq removes contaminating partitions computationally to improve platelet RNA-seq purity and sensitivity. COMET and LongReadClock assign bulk long reads to cell types using methylation, the latter for epigenetic aging clocks. NanoHIV-DR adds consensus and read-level HIV-1 drug resistance profiling from Oxford Nanopore reads. The newer element is cell-type or purity-aware interpretation of long-read and RNA data, paired with explicit control-based evaluation.
